name: Config Sync
author: ryankuo
description: Detect installed apps and their config files, then sync the ones you choose across machines. Small configs go through a git repo; large personal files go through rsync to a Google Drive folder. Watching uses Omarchy's own rsw watchers, one per path, with a periodic full pass for changes made on other machines. When the same file changed on two machines both versions are kept, removals move to a trash folder you can restore from, and secrets are never touched.

barWidget.description: Pick which app configs and folders sync, and where they go
